content.comment_body: Hello, I am facing a problem. I want to use four analog inputs (i7, i8, and i3, i4). I changed the settings for i3 and i4, but after downloading the program, outputs q3 and q4 flash, even without any wires or sensors connected to these inputs. Do I need to adjust additional settings for i3 and i4? Are these inputs only analog, or can they also be digital? Where can I set them to strictly analog? I’d appreciate urgent help, as I need to finish today. Thank you!

Dear [user_name], if we’re referring to [product_name] with [article_no], the digital inputs that can be configured as analog are I1, I2 (AI3-AI4), and I7, I8 (AI1-AI2), not I3 and I4. To use 4 analog inputs on the central unit, go to File > Properties > Parameter, and select 2 or 4 analog inputs for the device.

Maybe I didn’t explain well. I have those analog inputs set, as you mentioned, and I tried both 2AI and 4AI in the settings. Still, after downloading the program, outputs q3 and q4, linked to ai3 and ai4, keep flashing without any wire connected. It seems these outputs are being triggered continuously.
Input selection is shown in a diagram, but you must use [product_name] with [article_no].
What is between the analog inputs and the outputs? How is the digital output activation controlled? Please share your program and we will review it.
I have [product_name] with [article_no]. Here’s my program: I forgot to mention, the first part works well (outputs q1, q2). The issue is in the second part.
[user_name], what’s your goal? Turn on at 5050 and off at 6050? You’re correct, the issue only appears in the second part and the output flickers.

This isn’t my program, so I’m not sure what the exact intent is. I observed that the first part works fine, but the second part outputs are flashing. The developer told me the values aren’t fixed and that’s not the problem, since half of the program works. Thanks!
Try reducing the comparator output by adding a small delay (a few milliseconds). The help documentation for the comparator describes this procedure.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering confusion and unexpected module behavior when setting up analog inputs on [product_name], especially when attempting to configure digital inputs (I3, I4) to function as analog. Unexpected flashing of outputs (q3, q4) without sensors connected suggests phantom triggering, often due to unclear input configuration settings. The main pain point is the non-intuitive parameterization process and insufficient user interface guidance regarding usable analog inputs in the [article_no] variant. Users also struggle with lack of clear diagnostics for output activation in absence of valid input signals.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect simple methods to configure digital inputs as analog, clear guidance for input setup, and that outputs remain inactive without analog signals. They prefer straightforward feedback or troubleshooting tips, provided by either the software or hardware, to clarify abnormal output activity.
